title: Chewbacca
description: CHEW'BACCA is a Wookiee from the planet Kashyyyk. A born fighter, he is especially proficient with an antique weapon, the bow-caster, which shoots explosive projectiles. He is a natural mechanic who can get even the most stubborn starship running. Captured and enslaved by Imperial forces, he was rescued by Han Solo and joined the Corellian in his galaxy-wide exploits—including helping the Rebel Alliance in its fiercest battles.
